# Nonprofit Locator

> > A comprehensive nonprofit directory and search database providing contact information, financial data, and statistics for tax-exempt organizations across all U.S. states.

Nonprofit Locator is a searchable database that helps users find and research nonprofit organizations by state and location. The platform aggregates nonprofit statistics, assets, income data, and organizational details to support donors, researchers, and those seeking nonprofit services.
